# Kwai Developer Platform
> Developer resources for integrating with Kwai’s advertising, business, and API platform.

Kwai provides documentation and platform resources for advertisers, partners, and developers building against Kwai’s business and marketing ecosystem.

## Developer Portal
- [Developer Home](https://kwai.net/): Main entry point for Kwai developer and business platform resources.
- [Documentation](https://kwai.net/doc): Central documentation hub for platform guides, references, and integration materials.
- [Help Center](https://kwai.net/help): Support and help resources for common platform questions and workflows.
- [Contact Us](https://kwai.net/contact): Contact page for reaching Kwai platform and business support teams.

## Getting Started
- [Quick Start](https://kwai.net/doc/guide): Introductory guidance for beginning integration with Kwai platform capabilities.
- [Developer Access](https://kwai.net/doc/access): Information on obtaining access, credentials, and developer permissions.
- [Authentication](https://kwai.net/doc/authentication): Overview of authentication flows and credential usage for API access.
- [Integration Overview](https://kwai.net/doc/overview): High-level introduction to platform concepts, products, and integration patterns.

## API Documentation
- [API Reference](https://kwai.net/doc/api): Main API reference for available endpoints and request formats.
- [Open Platform APIs](https://kwai.net/doc/api/open): Reference for open platform endpoints and supported operations.
- [Marketing API](https://kwai.net/doc/api/marketing): API documentation for advertising and campaign management workflows.
- [Business API](https://kwai.net/doc/api/business): Reference for business-related endpoints, entities, and operations.
- [Error Codes](https://kwai.net/doc/api/errors): Error code definitions and troubleshooting information for API responses.

## Account and Authorization
- [Account Management](https://kwai.net/doc/account): Documentation for managing developer and business account settings.
- [OAuth Guide](https://kwai.net/doc/oauth): Authorization flow details for connecting applications to Kwai accounts.
- [Permissions](https://kwai.net/doc/permissions): Explanation of scopes, permissions, and access control requirements.
- [Token Management](https://kwai.net/doc/token): Guidance on issuing, refreshing, and securely storing access tokens.

## Advertising and Campaigns
- [Ads Overview](https://kwai.net/doc/ads): Introduction to Kwai advertising products and campaign capabilities.
- [Campaign Management](https://kwai.net/doc/ads/campaign): Documentation for creating and managing advertising campaigns.
- [Ad Groups](https://kwai.net/doc/ads/adgroup): Reference for ad group configuration and delivery settings.
- [Creative Management](https://kwai.net/doc/ads/creative): Guidance for managing ad creatives and associated assets.
- [Reporting](https://kwai.net/doc/ads/reporting): Reporting endpoints and metrics for campaign performance analysis.

## Data and Reporting
- [Reporting API](https://kwai.net/doc/reporting): Reference for retrieving analytics and reporting data programmatically.
- [Metrics Definitions](https://kwai.net/doc/reporting/metrics): Definitions for supported reporting dimensions and metrics.
- [Attribution](https://kwai.net/doc/reporting/attribution): Documentation for attribution logic and measurement concepts.
- [Data Export](https://kwai.net/doc/reporting/export): Guidance for exporting reporting data and handling large datasets.

## Tools and Resources
- [SDK Resources](https://kwai.net/doc/sdk): SDK-related documentation and integration support materials.
- [Postman Collection](https://kwai.net/doc/postman): API testing resources and collection guidance for developers.
- [Webhook Guide](https://kwai.net/doc/webhook): Documentation for webhook events, delivery, and endpoint handling.
- [Changelog](https://kwai.net/doc/changelog): Release notes and updates to APIs, features, and documentation.

## Support
- [FAQ](https://kwai.net/help/faq): Frequently asked questions about platform setup and usage.
- [Troubleshooting](https://kwai.net/help/troubleshooting): Common issues and recommended debugging steps for integrations.
- [Policy Center](https://kwai.net/help/policy): Platform policies, compliance requirements, and usage rules.
- [Support Contact](https://kwai.net/help/support): Support channels for technical and account-related assistance.
